basic_info.description: Welcome to your urban oasis in the heart of San Francisco! With its open plan living space, this serene condo - with abundant natural daylight - is designed for comfort. The living area seamlessly integrates with the kitchen, featuring stainless steel appliances and a serving bar, perfect for casual dining or social gatherings. You'll love the way your new home overlooks the tree-lined Jackson Street and a serene redwood grove.  Retreat to the spacious primary bedroom with its en suite bath and walk-in closet, while the guest bedroom provides privacy and works perfectly as a home office. The in-unit laundry adds convenience to your daily routine. Enjoy the luxury of assigned garage parking with elevator access, and additional private storage. Step outside to the sunny courtyard with a heated pool and spa, perfect for unwinding. Stay active with a gym available for residents, and rest easy with security and on-site management ensuring peace of mind.    Located in the coveted Pacific Heights neighborhood, you'll be just moments away from vibrant dining and shopping on Fillmore, Upper Polk, and Union Streets, plus San Francisco's cultural center. Easy access to public transportation.
